title: Zeus daemon API v1
description: JSON-RPC 2.0, one message per line, over the local endpoint of zeusd. Normative text: docs/spec/05-daemon-api-v1.md (prose wins over this schema). Per method: <Name>Params, <Name>Result, <Name>Request, <Name>Response, where <Name> is the method name in PascalCase without dots (jobs.enqueue -> JobsEnqueue).

RequestId.description: Chosen by the requester, unique among its in-flight requests on the connection (section 4.4).

Cursor.description: Opaque; valid only for the same method and filters. At most 512 characters.

limit.description: Page size. Absent: 50. Values above 100 are treated as 100; 0 is invalid.

Nonce.description: 32 random bytes as 64 lowercase hex digits, fresh per connection.

CredentialId.description: Client credential id (00 section 5.1 prefix cli_).

InstanceId.description: Random id of one daemon run, 32 lowercase hex digits.

EventSeqOrZero.description: An event sequence (00 section 5.2) or 0 meaning none.

ClientRole.description: The concrete program behind a credential (section 7.2).

HumanChannel.description: A trust surface reachable over the daemon API (section 9.4). Extension surfaces act only through nm.frame.

PathText.description: An absolute path on the daemon host, or a path relative to a write root where the method says so. At most 4096 bytes.

ErrorResponse.description: A failed call. data always carries the 00 error envelope.

id.description: Null only when the request id could not be read.

name.description: Program name. Self-declared, untrusted, for logs only.

max_request_bytes.description: Longest line the daemon accepts from this client.

max_response_bytes.description: Longest line the daemon sends to this client.

event_buffer.description: Events queued per subscription before events.lagged.

attested_extension.description: Extension id taken from the host argv and found in the host allow-list (02 section 3.4).

parent_verified.description: The host found its parent process (or, on Windows, the grandparent behind cmd.exe) to be a registered browser executable (07 section 7.4).

pid.description: Informational. Liveness is decided by connecting, never by the pid.

endpoint.description: Full pipe name or absolute socket path.

ServiceRoot.description: A write root registered by a service client (section 7.6).

path.description: Absolute, canonical path of the root.

ClientRecord.description: A client credential as the daemon describes it. Never contains the token or its verifier.

roots.description: Service clients only: their registered roots.

JobSpecView.description: A JobSpec (01 section 3.2) with every URL redacted (00 section 8.2, mode log) and header values removed.

extra_header_names.description: Names only; values are never returned.

JobView.description: The Job of 01 section 3.1 safe for any client: spec replaced by JobSpecView.

NewJob.description: The caller-settable fields of a JobSpec (01 section 3.2). There is no source and no run_id: the daemon derives the source from the connection (section 7.2).

extra_headers.description: At most 16; names from the allow-list of 01 section 3.2 (case-insensitive). Values are secrets for logging purposes.

EnqueuedJob.description: One entry per requested job, in request order: job_id and state, or plan (dry run), or error.

ApprovalView.description: An approval as the API returns it: the ApprovalRequest of 07 (01 Approval plus request_hash, requested_by, revision, facts, agent_says). Section 9.5.

root.description: The write root containing the file (absolute).

path.description: Path relative to root. Untrusted data.

partial.description: True for the .zpart file of an unfinished job.

artifact_id.description: Null for a content-only node (13 section 4.3).

links.description: Indexes into nodes: the parents (ancestors) or children (descendants), with the parent role.

downgraded.description: True when kind is lower than credential_kind (07 section 7.2).

jobs.description: Job counts per state; states with zero jobs may be omitted.

LlmConfigureParams.description: Human-only local model configuration. Download-only remains the default; enabling a model never grants download or session authority.

Request.description: Any request a client may send (section 9).

resume_from_seq.description: Pass as since_seq to a new events.subscribe to continue without a gap.

source.description: extension (default) or host for frames the host synthesises (section 9.12).

ClientNotification.description: The only notification a client may send: nm.frame from a native_host connection.

endpoint.description: Complete method URL. Credentials, query strings, fragments and non-loopback cleartext are refused.

authorization_url.description: One-use browser sign-in URL. Never log or expose to agent clients.

WorkflowDraftRequest.description: A model-drafting request (human-only, verified terminal). The model sees text-free page outlines under metadata_only (09) and proposes only the extract member.

max_cost_micro_usd.description: Most this one request may cost, in micro-USD; zero allows only free local models.

WorkflowDraftInfo.description: Accounting of a model draft. A proposal, never an approval.

ArtifactRetention.description: Object protection selected for an active artifact record.

oneOf.description: Protect the stored content while this record remains active.
Permit later collection when no other record or lease protects the content.

ArtifactLifecycleOperation.description: One explicit artifact lifecycle effect. Collection and quarantine release are separate policies.

oneOf.description: Tombstone the record. User files, materializations and shared content remain untouched.
Change object protection. Weakening protection requires a person's approval.

retain_until.description: Additional protection deadline, or no deadline.

oneOf.description: Copy verified bytes to a new file inside a write root visible to this caller.

path.description: Absolute destination; existing files and partial files are never replaced.

ArtifactLifecyclePlan.description: An exact preview accepted by `artifacts.lifecycle.apply`; requester edits are revalidated by the daemon.

expected_record_blake3.description: BLAKE3 of the canonical API export before the change (the expected record revision).

expires_at.description: Preview expiration; no more than 15 minutes after it is produced.

operation.description: Complete effect, including the daemon-resolved destination when copying.

quarantined.description: Quarantine state; this operation cannot clear it.

requires_approval.description: A human `destructive_op` approval is required before this effect can execute.

ArtifactsLifecyclePreviewParams.description: `artifacts.lifecycle.preview` parameters. This method does not persist or execute a plan.

ArtifactsLifecyclePreviewResult.description: `artifacts.lifecycle.preview` result. Save this entire receipt for a later apply.

plan.description: Daemon-computed effect and expected record snapshot.

ArtifactsLifecycleApplyParams.description: `artifacts.lifecycle.apply` parameters. Repeat this exact request after a person approves it.

idempotency_key.description: Required retry key: 1 to 128 UTF-8 bytes, without control characters.

ArtifactsLifecycleApplyResult.description: A pending approval or a durable completed lifecycle receipt.

approval_id.description: Existing approval to review; the API never approves it on the caller's behalf.

artifact.description: Portable record after completion, including its tombstone for deletion.

path.description: Materialized destination, when this effect copied bytes.

replayed.description: This call reused a pending request or completed durable receipt.

FilesOperationGetParams.description: Read one durable organizer operation visible to the caller.

operation_id.description: Operation identifier returned by organize or undo.

FilesOperationGetResult.description: Current organization progress. Read-only; no file paths outside the caller's view.

approval_id.description: Human request associated with the exact operation.

completed.description: Completed effects, including partial success before a stop.

pending.description: Steps not yet started or reconciled.

skipped.description: Steps skipped because their preconditions changed.

state.description: awaiting_approval, applying, applied, dropped or stopped.

items.description: One step of a file plan.

destructive.description: Whether this step deletes or overwrites (needs approval to apply).

from.description: Source path relative to the root.

to.description: Destination path relative to the root, for non-trash operations.

replayed.description: True when this response replays a durable mutation receipt.

QueueView.description: A queue with its live state.

builtin.description: True for the queue that cannot be deleted.

finished_at_ms.description: When the queue last ran out of work after running.

held_job_ids.description: The members the daemon holds back (paused until the queue releases them).

items.description: Identifier with the prefix `job_` followed by a 26 character ULID.

last_started_ms.description: When it last started (milliseconds since the Unix epoch).

limit_kib_s.description: KiB/s for the whole queue; `null` means no queue limit.

next_start_ms.description: The next scheduled start, if the schedule has one.

next_stop_ms.description: The next scheduled stop of the current run, if there is one.

on_finish.description: What happens when the queue has no work left.

order.description: Member downloads that are not finished, in release order.

retries.description: Extra automatic retries of a failed download when its error is retryable, 0 to 50.

retry_delay_s.description: Seconds to wait before each of those retries, 1 to 3600.

running.description: The queue is running: it releases downloads.

sync_files.description: Completed files watched by this synchronization queue.

waiting.description: Members waiting for a turn (held by the daemon).

job_id.description: Latest completed version, whose destination is retained for the next version.

last_checked_ms.description: Last probe time in Unix milliseconds.

next_check_ms.description: Earliest next probe time in Unix milliseconds.

pending_job_id.description: New version in progress, if any.

SyncStatus.description: Result of the last synchronization check; no URL or credential is exposed.

oneOf.description: The first check has not run.
Strong representation validators matched.
A new version is downloading beside the previous file.
A new version completed.
Strong validators or a compatible unpinned request are unavailable.
The provider requires a current session grant.
Signed team restrictions or requester permissions currently prohibit a new transfer.
The check or new download failed; the old version remains intact.

QueueSchedule.description:
When a queue starts and stops. Times are wall-clock `HH:MM` in the configured time zone; days are 0 (Sunday)
to 6. A stop time earlier than the start time means the window runs past midnight.

oneOf.description: Starts once, on `start_date`.
Starts on each listed weekday.

OnFinish.description:
What happens when a queue has no work left. The daemon performs `stop_limiter` itself; the application that
started the daemon performs the others when it sees `finish_action_pending`.

oneOf.description: Nothing.
Tell the person.
Turn the speed limiter off.
Close the application.
Put the computer to sleep.
Downloads each file once.
Keeps checking completed downloads for a new strongly identified version.

now_ms.description: The daemon's clock (milliseconds since the Unix epoch).

queues.description: Every queue, the built-in one first.

utc_offset_min.description: Offset of the schedule clock from UTC in minutes right now (0 for UTC).

held_jobs.description: Number of jobs held by this policy, excluding manual pauses.

paused.description: The policy is holding downloads and synchronization probes.

NetworkCost.description: The current operating-system or explicit network-cost hint.

oneOf.description: No trustworthy cost hint is available; this does not assert an unmetered connection.

LimiterView.description: The limiter with what it does right now.

schedule_enabled.description: Apply only inside the window below.

to.description: Window end, `HH:MM`; earlier than `from` means past midnight.

QueueDefaults.description: Defaults that apply to every queue.

default_queue.description: The queue a download joins when its sender names none and queueing is wanted.

missed_window.description: What to do about a start missed while the daemon was off.

pause_on_metered.description: Hold active downloads while the cost is metered.

stop_behaviour.description: What a scheduled stop does to running downloads.

timezone.description: Clock for schedules and the limiter window.

Timezone.description: Which clock queue schedules and the limiter window follow.

oneOf.description: The computer's local time.
